prompt: An $18$ ft ladder leans against a wall, making a $72^\circ$ angle with the ground. How far up the wall does the ladder reach? Round to the nearest tenth of a foot.
hint: The ladder is the hypotenuse; the height on the wall is opposite the $72^\circ$ angle.

hints.text: The ladder is the hypotenuse; the height on the wall is opposite the $72^\circ$ angle.

explanation: The ladder itself is the hypotenuse, $18$ ft, and the wall height is opposite the $72^\circ$ angle.
Since $\sin 72^\circ \approx 0.9511$, the height is about $17.1$ ft.

alternativeExplanations.title: Sanity-check the size
steps: A steep $72^\circ$ ladder is nearly upright, so the height should be close to but a little less than the full 18 ft.
$17.1$ ft fits perfectly; an answer like $5.6$ ft would mean the ladder was almost flat on the ground.
